subject: asp-es
title: (R)ASP.ES.------P.PROG.
description: Chart on book p. 78 (CS-6). ASP-ES (aspect essence) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; P-PROG (particular progressionalism) is the partner. From the subject: AFN (affinity negation). From AFN: INFO-ALGN (information alignment). From INFO-ALGN: IST-F (isolated focus), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix. From IST-F: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From APP-RDEF: GRAD (gradualism), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". From GRAD: POL-DYM (political dynamics).
